title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.13
body_markdown:
*released April 8th, 2025*

### What's New in this Release

* Added support for modern TFVC Check-in Policies, as well as guidance and warnings when obsolete TFVC Check-in Policies are being applied.

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2025-29802**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-29802) Visual Studio node.js Untrusted Search Path Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
* [**CVE-2025-29804**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-29803) Visual Studio Adroid JDK Untrusted Search Path Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
* [**CVE-2025-26682**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-26682) ASP.NET Core 8 Denial of Service with HTTP/3
